study: issue 121 duplicate-audit study: the frozen protocol

corpus_pages.rule: Every page listed in corpus.json must exist under root and hash to its entry's sha256, as eval/similar/rank.py's check_frozen checks it.

development.rule: Before any held-out page is extracted, the three candidates run once on cycle 10's frozen corpus and labels under the index and query rule below; counts are taken as on the held-out set. Its counts never decide a pass; they are reported as committed and the candidates are not run on that corpus again for any reading (a CI test may only reproduce the committed bytes).
development.stop_rule: The held-out stage goes ahead only if at least one candidate's false pairs on the development corpus do not outnumber its true pairs found there (false <= true); otherwise the bet stops (trigger 0).
development.stage_line_rule: report.md holds exactly one development stage line.

index.slug_rule: eval.similar.rank.slug_paths over the set's corpus.json entries in order (cycle 11's slug and collision rule, imported, not restated).
index.build: One in-memory FTS5 table over every page of the set, rows in corpus.json order, each row search_index.build_document(<slug path>, <page text>), tokenizer DEFAULT_RANKER_CONFIG.tokenizer.
index.ranking: For page A: A's row is deleted; SearchIndex.rank(similar_query(<A's text>), order=<every other page's slug path in corpus.json order>, weights=DEFAULT_RANKER_CONFIG.weights, min_match_tokens=DEFAULT_RANKER_CONFIG.min_match_tokens) ranks the rest; A's row is inserted back before the next page is ranked. rank returns only pages matching at least one query token, best bm25 first, ties by position in order.
index.list: A's list is the compared pages, best first; a rank is the 1-based position in it; a page not in A's list has no rank there. The lists are computed once per set and every k is read from them.

query_rule: discovery.similar_query: the frontmatter title, one space, the body after the frontmatter.
page_type_rule: The compared pages are the ranked pages whose frontmatter page_type (review.frontmatter_value) equals A's; every page of both sets is a decision page and none is superseded, so the filter keeps all of them; it is applied so the measured path is the shipped one.
flag_rule: The unordered pair {A, B} is flagged at k when B is in A's first k and A is in B's first k. Each flagged pair carries both ranks (B's in A's list, A's in B's list). No score floor and no other candidate.
label_rule: A pair's label is its disposition in the set's labels.json pairs or cross_pairs, else unrelated. n is the number of true pairs in the labels; the true pairs found are the flagged true pairs.

restatement.source: the two pages' corpus.json entries only

rules.what: Both pages come from the same spec directory: the same repository and the same directory part of spec_path (a directory in another repository is another directory).

One page comes from a pitch (spec_path specs/pitches/<id>/pitch.md) and the other from a spec bundle of the same repository (spec_path specs/<name>/plan.md or specs/<name>/spec.md) whose origin_issue is an integer equal to the leading number of the pitch id (the run of digits the id starts with; an id with none never meets b).
Both pages come from pitch files.

restatement.naming: A pair that meets a rule is named by the first rule it meets, in the order a, b, c; every other pair is not a restatement.
restatement.no_origin_issue: A spec bundle with no origin_issue never meets b: on the held-out set wiki-studio-0-1-0 and wiki-studio-0-6-0 (plan, O3), and every memkernel bundle, whose origin_issue is null because its issue line is a string.
restatement.development_set: Cycle 10's corpus holds no pitch and no source_kind or origin_issue fields (read as null), so only a can apply there.

pair_scopes.one-feature: restatement rule a or b holds
pair_scopes.within-repository: otherwise, both pages share a repository

bar.rule: A candidate passes when all four hold: (1) n >= min_true_pairs, else the verdict is not testable, never a pass; (2) 4 * found >= 3 * n, counted per true pair; (3) false <= true, true being the true pairs found; (4) at least min_non_restatement_found of its true pairs found are not restatements.

selection.rule: Among passing candidates, the fewest false pairs per true pair wins: A beats B when false_A * true_B < false_B * true_A.

verdict_rule: winner when a candidate passes; no candidate clears the bar when n >= 8 and none passes; not testable when n < 8.
winner_line_rule: report.md holds exactly one winner line. Winner: none goes with the verdicts no candidate clears the bar and not testable. Nothing else counts toward the verdict.

repositories.sources: every specs/<name>/plan.md and specs/<name>/spec.md (plan before spec) and every specs/pitches/<id>/pitch.md at the pin, with no exclusion
specs/<name>/plan.md and specs/<name>/spec.md (plan before spec) of the two directories only

held_out.pin_resolution: wiki-studio: git rev-parse --verify 04009eedfb25b5f27d898c5fdfd0bc4ee1bb1c86^{commit}; memkernel: git -C ../memkernel rev-parse --verify main^{commit} when US1 ran, both directories checked with git -C ../memkernel ls-tree --name-only <pin> -- specs/; commit dates from git log -1.
held_out.extraction_rule: Cycle 10's rule, unchanged and not tuned (specs/wiki-studio-duplicates-121/spec.md FR-004 to FR-007; eval/duplicates/README.md), applied through eval/duplicates/extract.py's own functions imported read-only. An item extracted badly is kept as written and listed in held-out/README.md; an item left out still takes its ordinal.

slug_rule.nn: the item's 1-based ordinal in its file, two digits

held_out.page_path: held-out/corpus/<repository>/<slug>.md; an entry's page is that path relative to held-out/corpus/

corpus_json.order: pages sorted by page, as cycle 10's corpus.json
corpus_json.origin_issue: for a spec page, the integer on the issue: line inside the origin: block of its bundle's plan.md frontmatter at the pin, else null; for a pitch page, null

held_out.narrowing: trigger 2: run with --wiki-studio-only, memkernel is dropped and wiki_studio_only is recorded as true

labelling.rule: As cycle 10 (specs/wiki-studio-duplicates-121/spec.md FR-013 to FR-016), per family: the labeller reads every page, groups pages that answer the same question, gives each in-group pair one disposition of the six with a one-line reason naming the question; a within-family pair outside every group is unrelated; one summary pass over all families (one line per group, one per page in no group) lists cross-repository pairs, each read before labelling; an unlisted cross pair is unrelated. A pitch decision and the spec decision it restates are labelled by content like any pair.
labelling.isolation: The labeller never opens eval/duplicate_audit/audit.py, eval/duplicate_audit/results/, report.md, or any results/ directory under eval/, and runs no script.

review_sample.population: the within-family pairs whose label is false
review_sample.shortfall: a family with fewer false pairs than its share gives all it has and the rest come from the other family
review_sample.when: once, from the labelling commit's labels, before any owner change; never re-drawn

held_out.owner_review: every true and companion label, every listed cross pair and the 20 sampled pairs; changes land as commits before the freeze
held_out.freeze: With fewer than 8 true pairs the verdict is not testable, stated in held-out/freeze.json before any candidate runs on the set; the audit still runs and is published. No candidate runs on the held-out set before freeze.json exists. No source is added after labelling starts.

time_bound.cycle_rule: The frozen held-out pages in corpus.json order, cycled to 500: for i = 0 to 499, page i is held-out page i mod N; copy c = i div N sits at the page's title-slug path, with -c<c> appended to the stem for c >= 1; an index.md links all 500 in that order; a log.md is present.
time_bound.measure: the wall time of one findings run with the switch on minus one with it off, on that wiki
time_bound.early_sign: the audit script records its own pass time on this wiki
time_bound.miss: the kind is cut (trigger 5), never replaced by a faster rule

not_binding.per_100_pages: per candidate, counts per 100 pages, two decimals
not_binding.by_scope_and_restatement: flagged pairs by pair scope and by restatement or not
not_binding.groups: the groups with at least one flagged true pair (pitch, finding 11)
not_binding.no_origin_issue_bundles: the true pairs found that are not restatements and involve wiki-studio-0-1-0 or wiki-studio-0-6-0, listed (plan, O3)
not_binding.development: the development stage's counts, copied as committed
not_binding.post_hoc: Anything found after a run goes into a post_hoc block of that run's results file marked "binding": false, computed by audit.py with its rule in one constant, and a 'Post hoc (not binding)' report section. It never changes a candidate, k, the index rule, the restatement rule, the bar, a label or a verdict line.

caveat: Cycle 10's 8 true pairs have been read by three cycles and are development data; the pitch's finding 7 did arithmetic on published ranks while shaping; the held-out set is the only binding evidence.
